criteria.finding: Worker deliverable describes layout breakpoints at desktop, tablet, 800px, and 480px (below the 390px spec), collapsing navigation, single-column grids, stacked proof records, and form controls within viewport. Evidence is textual only without a live deployment screenshot or device test log, so full confidence is limited; partial credit supported.
criteria.name: Responsive design

criteria.finding: Worker listed all five required application areas (case desk, new agreement, lifecycle actions, evidence lab, protocol documentation) matching the agreement terms. No counter-evidence was submitted by the client on this criterion.
criteria.name: Five complete pages

criteria.finding: Both worker and client evidence agree that the Connect Wallet control does not call eth_requestAccounts, no address is displayed, and chain detection/switching cannot be reached. Agreement terms explicitly state 'A decorative control does not satisfy this requirement.' Only a visible UI element is present, with no functional provider call.
criteria.name: Working MetaMask wallet integration

criteria.finding: Worker states repository and public deployment were supplied before the agreement submission timestamp; client dispute does not contest timeliness. Substantive on-time delivery is supported by both parties' statements.
criteria.name: Delivery by the committed deadline

risk_flags: Responsive design evidence is self-described without authenticated device test screenshots; 390px breakpoint compliance inferred from 480px breakpoint mention only
Deadline evidence relies on worker statement with no independent timestamp attestation
summary: The worker fulfilled responsive design, five pages, and timely delivery, but both parties' authenticated evidence confirms the MetaMask integration is non-functional (no eth_requestAccounts call). Applying the locked weights (2500+2500+2000+3000 = 10000 bps): weighted score = (85×2500 + 90×2500 + 10×2000 + 90×3000)/10000 = (212500 + 225000 + 20000 + 270000)/10000 = 72.75% worker payout, 27.25% client remainder.
